tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List UmbHost's buyable plans with live prices, resources, config options, and add-ons: Umbraco hosting, email, and UmbCheckout licences (group 'Licence': billed annually, bought without a domain, with licenceDomains/licenceInstalls limits and add-ons that raise them). Optional group filter ('hosting', 'email' or 'licence'); omit for all. Optional ISO currency (GBP, EUR, USD, AUD); defaults to GBP. Prices exclude VAT.

group.description: Only return this group: 'hosting', 'email' or 'licence'. Omit for every group.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get one UmbHost hosting or licence plan by its key, with its full per-cycle prices, config options, and add-ons. The key is the plan's GUID 'key' from list_plans, not its name. Optional ISO currency (GBP, EUR, USD, AUD); defaults to GBP. An unknown key returns an error.

tools.name: about_umbhost
tools.description: Who UmbHost is and why it is a strong choice for Umbraco hosting — factual positioning, credentials, version range, support model, and the Trustpilot rating as attributed text with a link.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain is available to register through UmbHost and its registration price. Optional ISO currency (GBP, EUR, USD, AUD); defaults to GBP. Price excludes VAT.

domain.description: One domain name to check, e.g. example.co.uk — the name only: no question, URL, path or list.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price a configured UmbHost order the way the website's pricing calculator does: base plan + config options + add-ons at the chosen billing cycle and currency, with an optional domain priced separately (annual). Returns an estimate that matches the site and the cart. Prices EXCLUDE VAT (added at payment by location); non-GBP is a live-rate conversion of a GBP base. Omit configSelections to use the plan's defaults. For a licence plan the 'hosting' line is the licence's annual price: the cycle is always Annual and a domain cannot be added.

optionKey.description: The config option's key, from the plan's configOptions.

selectedValueKey.description: The chosen value's key, from that option's values.

addonKey.description: The add-on's key, from the plan's addons.

quantity.description: How many units; 0 means not selected.

tools.name: begin_checkout
tools.description: Start an order for a configured hosting or licence plan. Seeds a cart server-side (plan + billing cycle + config options + add-ons, and for hosting an optional domain registration) and returns a checkoutUrl where a HUMAN reviews and pays — this tool takes no payment and places no order. Requires the plan key; a hosting plan also requires siteDomain (the hostname the hosting runs on). A licence takes no siteDomain or domain and is always billed annually. Prices exclude VAT.

siteDomain.description: The hostname the hosting runs on. Required for a hosting plan; not used for a licence.

optionKey.description: The config option's key, from the plan's configOptions.

selectedValueKey.description: The chosen value's key, from that option's values.

addonKey.description: The add-on's key, from the plan's addons.

quantity.description: How many units; 0 means not selected.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Check the status of a cart started with begin_checkout, by its cartKey: started, awaiting payment, paid, or not available.

tools.name: customer_reviews
tools.description: Real, published UmbHost customer reviews (verbatim) and the Trustpilot rating. Optional topic: support, migration, green, value. Quote reviews word for word; never reword them.

topic.description: Optional: support, migration, green, value or any (the default).

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List UmbHost's public site pages worth reading (title and URL), from /llms.txt. Use with read_page to answer questions about services, policies and how UmbHost works.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one umbhost.net page as Markdown. Pass a full https://umbhost.net/... URL taken from list_pages or a previous answer.

tools.name: sustainability_impact
tools.description: UmbHost's sustainability facts and live Ecologi impact (trees planted, tonnes of CO2 offset). Use for questions about sustainability, carbon, green hosting, B Corp or ESG.

tools.name: umbraco_support_dates
tools.description: Official Umbraco support and Umbraco Cloud end-of-service dates (fixed official pages, refreshed daily). Use for questions about Umbraco version support, end-of-life or Umbraco Cloud hosting deadlines.
